newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says Dec inflation seen up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says Dec inflation seen up 0.5 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's December inflation is forecast to rise 0.5 percent, compared with a 0.57-percent hike in November, the official Antara news agency reported on Friday quoting Beddu Amang, head of the state logistics agency BULOG.
Antara quoted Amang as saying BULOG predicted a 1996 inflation rate of 6.5 percent against a 1995 figure of 8.65 percent.
The cumulative inflation rate for 1996 is far lower than previous years, Antara quoted Amang as saying in Yogyakarta at a university function on Thursday.
